## p59 A1 — Poti horse transport: conditional first-part reading

**Edition context:** Poti horse transport: a conditional first-part edition.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-poti-horse-transport-a-conditional-first-part-edition"></a>



**Source review and edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

This is a conditional partial edition of the previously uncounted first part of the [Poti horse-delivery exchange](#edition-cases-caucasus-poti-horse-delivery). The original source has **225 positions** under the printed label **RICHI-220**. Its two transport clauses and footer can be repaired at a small explicit cost. A separate repeated-field extension now supplies three conditional letters, reaching **108/110** positions while retaining the original frame alternatives, unread opening and competing vessel-like labels.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-source-and-complete-frame-comparison"></a>

### Source and complete frame comparison

The [existing public source crop](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/sources/p59_A1.png) retains every printed group and dash. Header: `SSD, COS v ASO (07.50 a.m., September 22nd); 2250 (21.9) 3 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-220`. The [literal inputs](../experiments/poti_first_part_conditional/inputs.json) bind the earlier source edition without altering it.

The exact search prices **all 4,595,146,920 ways to exclude five of the 225 positions**, using dynamic programming. Only six ordinary transport-word spans are constrained; the opening, names and numbers are left free. The minimum is **five changed observed coordinates and two printed-mask fills**, after the separately declared **five exclusions**. There are **21 minimum source maps and eight distinct raw streams**. All are preserved, including their different prefix labels and first date-like fields. This is a bounded model result, not a proof that any five-coordinate deletion occurred historically.

The representative below excludes source indices 200–204, the visible `AFFDD` group. No cancellation mark on the source licenses that choice. It is retained because it was already one of the earlier illustrative frames, not because its prefix digits look more plausible.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-representative-raw-and-limited-repair"></a>

### Representative raw and limited repair

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — conditional 220-coordinate frame after the five disclosed exclusions; unchanged Sep19–21 key:**

```text
6X??FFQ274XHG6AM11X9XAUF9AMPF?RXVUR?A4VA?NAX5XBATTAAM15X9XAUFDAM?FZRXBURDALXBYRDA?XINSGYSAWT52PFERDENAUHXPOTI0
```

**Edited output — the same conditional frame, five observed-coordinate substitutions and two printed-mask fills; all other labels retained:**

```text
6X??FFQ274XHG6AM11X9XAUFDAMPFERXVUR?A4VA?NAX5XBATTAAM15X9XAUFDAMPFERXBURDALXBYRDA?XINSGESAMT52PFERDENACHXPOTI0
```

</details>

**Readable German — all representative candidate labels retained; no vessel identification or date normalization:**

> 6 X ??FFQ274 X HG6 am 11 X 9 X auf Dampfer X VUR?A4VA?NA X 5 X BATT A am 15 X 9 X auf Dampfer X BURDAL X BYRDA? X insgesamt 52 Pferde nach X POTI0.

The two `AUF DAMPFER` clauses and the `INSGESAMT52PFERDENACH` footer support a limited horse-transport interpretation toward the literal `POTI0` ending. The separately printed second and third parts concern horses and Poti, which supplies context but does not identify the names or restore the opening. In this earlier 105/110 layer, `VUR?A4VA?NA`, `BURDAL` and `BYRDA?` remain opaque. The separate extension below transfers three missing letters; it does not identify either vessel with certainty.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-conditional-repeated-field-completion"></a>

### Conditional repeated-field completion

Each `AUF DAMPFER` clause is followed by two similar short fields. If each
pair repeats one label, and extra observed-coordinate changes are minimized,
three missing letters are common to every minimum-cost reconstruction:
**N at position 35**, **R at 40**, and **L at 81**. The corresponding letters
are directly present in the other copy at positions 41, 34 and 74.

| Raw pair in every retained frame | Minimum equal-copy alternatives | Common missing-letter transfers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VUR?A` / `VA?NA` | `VARNA` or `VURNA` | N into the first copy; R into the second |
| `BURDAL` / `BYRDA?` | `BURDAL` or `BYRDAL` | L into the second copy |

These are conditional repetition inferences. The source itself still fixes
103/110 positions under the five-exclusion frame. Transferring just the
three common letters gives **108/110**, at **four additional printed-mask
fills and no additional observed-coordinate substitutions**. N and R each
need one missing half; L needs both halves. The totals are **five observed
substitutions, six mask fills and five separately declared source
exclusions**. All 21 previously minimizing source maps remain represented.

**Readable German — the common extension, with the three conditional letters bracketed:**

> 6 X ??FFQ274 X HG6 am 11 X 9 X auf Dampfer X VUR[N]A4VA[R]NA X 5 X BATT A am 15 X 9 X auf Dampfer X BURDAL X BYRDA[L] X insgesamt 52 Pferde nach X POTI0.

The differing U/A and U/Y letters and the raw `4` remain literal in this
common layer. Enforcing identical complete copies costs one further observed
substitution for each pair and leaves **four joint minimum variants**; all
are retained. The extension does not silently choose `VARNA`, replace `4`
with a separator, or turn `BURDAL`/`BYRDAL` into a different ship name. The
two opening unknowns still permit **36** complete strings in each frame.

<details>
<summary>Common conditional extension and exact machine labels</summary>

**Edited output — three repetition-based letters; five substitutions and six mask fills after the existing five exclusions:**

```text
6X??FFQ274XHG6AM11X9XAUFDAMPFERXVURNA4VARNAX5XBATTAAM15X9XAUFDAMPFERXBURDALXBYRDALXINSGESAMT52PFERDENACHXPOTI0
```

</details>

For limited context, the shipping company's own
[history](https://navibulgar.com/en/company/history/index.php) records a
steamer *Varna* among deliveries in 1903–1906 and wartime mobilization of its
vessels in 1916–1918. A separate public
[photograph caption](https://www.flickr.com/photos/39631091@N03/15359293270/)
is titled *Poti, Ship Varna* and attributed by its uploader to a German
officer in winter 1918. Only the caption was inspected; this metadata does
not verify a September voyage or identify the telegram's vessel. These
contextual sources make `VARNA` plausible without selecting it by arithmetic.

The [extension package](../experiments/p59_repeated_vessel_labels/README.md)
records all label costs, all four equal-copy variants and exact source
ledgers for every retained frame. The original first-part edition and its
source inputs are preserved.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-alternative-frames-and-withheld-constraints"></a>

### Alternative frames and withheld constraints

The complete certificate preserves every minimizing source map, raw stream, repaired stream and source-coordinate ledger. It does not collapse numerically different branches into the representative display.

| Constraints used | Minimum observed substitutions | Printed-mask fills | Minimum maps |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Both steamer clauses only |2|2|812|
| Transport footer, with NACH withheld |1|0|359630|
| All spans except NACH |4|2|1146|
| All six spans |5|2|21|

The five exclusions are a separate structural cost in every row. Withholding words leaves more possible maps; the retained 21 are conditional on the declared word stencil. The unchanged native 225-coordinate stream is also recorded with its orphan coordinate and no hidden truncation.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional-reproduce-and-credit"></a>

### Reproduce and credit

```sh
python experiments/poti_first_part_conditional/verify.py --verify
python experiments/poti_first_part_conditional/verify.py --verify --pdf /path/to/adfgvx-childs.pdf
```

Childs source p59 and the published Sep19–21 key; earlier source transcription and A2/A3 edition retained. Joint frame pricing, constrained partial edition and complete alternative accounting: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No first-decipherment claim.

## Horses for a cavalry brigade: Poti shipment and handover inquiry

**Sources on this page:** p59 A2, p59 A3.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-horse-delivery-horses-for-a-cavalry-brigade-poti-shipment-and-handover-inquiry"></a>



**Source edition and verification: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

Childs p59 A, PDF page 62, contains three numbered parts under the header
`SSD, COS v ASO (07.50 a.m., September 22nd)`, followed by
`2250 (21.9) 3 TLE`. The second and third parts recover coherent passages
about a shipment at Poti for a cavalry brigade, an abteilung ordered
elsewhere, horses handed over at Poti, and an urgent request for a reply.
The incomplete preceding clause leaves the precise assertion or question
about the handover uncertain.

The **Sep19–21** key is unchanged. This edition counts **two** physical
records, with **225 plaintext positions**. The first part is preserved as
context outside this package's two-record totals because its 225 visible
source slots disagree with its printed length of 220. It now has a separate
[conditional catalogue entry](#edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional), with its
own declared frame model. It is not silently forced into the continuation.

### p59 A2

The [source crop](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/sources/p59_A2.png)
has **220 slots**, including seven printed dashes, exactly matching
`2 TL RICHI-220`.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — native 220-coordinate frame:**

```text
POTIXVERLADEBXDIEFUER7GBA8?BRIGXBE7THMMTXXDAABTEILUNGKNDERSHINBEO4DHGTXDRING?NDDRAHTEO?ERBRTVEXO0?NDWME??EL?XX
```

**Edited output — 11 observed-coordinate substitutions and three printed-dash fills:**

```text
POTIXVERLADENXDIEFUER7XKAVXBRIGXBESTIMMTXXDAABTEILUNGANDERSHINBEORDERTXDRINGENDDRAHTEODERBRTVEXO0?NDWME??EL?XX
```

</details>

**Readable German — spacing of the conservative partial candidate, with its opaque ending retained:**

> ... Poti verladen, die für 7. Kav. Brig. bestimmt. Da Abteilung
> andershin beordert. Dringend drahte oder BRTVE. O0?NDWME??EL? ...

The leading ellipsis marks missing syntactic context from the unresolved
first part, not an added coordinate gap in A2. The closing ellipsis marks
the unfinished syntax; it does not hide further decoded A2 labels. This reading fixes
**106 / 110 positions** after the disclosed edits. The abbreviation
`KAV` is an editorial word repair; its leading **7** is the unchanged
raw label. The final fragment remains unresolved and is not polished into
a complete sentence.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-horse-delivery-conditional-interpretation-of-the-opaque-ending"></a>

#### Conditional interpretation of the opaque ending

One contextually plausible extension is shown below. It requires **25
observed substitutions and seven dash fills in total**, or **14 additional
substitutions and four additional fills** beyond the conservative candidate.

**Conditional interpretation — costly full A2 hypothesis, excluded from the main reading counts:**

```text
POTIXVERLADENXDIEFUER7XKAVXBRIGXBESTIMMTXXDAABTEILUNGANDERSHINBEORDERTXDRINGENDDRAHTEODERBRIEFXOBUNDWEMDIESEXX
```

This would produce “... Brief ... ob und wem diese ...” before the next
part. It is guided by the following part and by language, with substantial
changes to observed source coordinates. It is not independent evidence
for the damaged letters. Its final `DIESE` and the next part's initial
`DIESE` are both retained; neither is deleted to smooth the join. The
certificate records its exact round trip and all additional costs separately.

The [source crop](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/sources/p59_A3.png)
contains **230 slots**, with **31 printed dashes**, matching
`3 TL RICHI-230`. Restoring the dash groups omitted by the earlier OCR

<details>

```text
D?ES?4?FER1E??X???I?EBERGE?E?WUGWE?XF?R?ERBALQIG?T?ANTWIRTA??UNSE?ZNFU??S1RZCH?79??7070V9?15X?XXXGEN?DOX?2XTBXP?47?
```

**Readable German — spacing and punctuation, with the unresolved reference fields kept literal:**

The ellipsis marks the unfinished preceding clause. The fragment can be

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-poti-horse-delivery-domains-source-costs-and-first-part-conflict"></a>

### Domains, source costs and first-part conflict

The [certificate](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/certificates.json)
lists every source-coordinate pair, raw domain, substitution, fill and
changed plaintext position. Raw fixed-position totals count single-symbol
algebraic domains, including erroneous received letters; they are not an
accuracy score for the historical reading.

The four remaining A2 erasures independently allow **1,296** complete
plaintexts. The eight remaining A3 erasures independently allow
**1,679,616**. These are exact factorized counts under the unchanged
complete square and the stated main edits, with finite re-encryption
witnesses retained. No completion is selected as historical.

The [first-part crop](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/sources/p59_A1.png)
shows **225 slots** under `RICHI-220`. All **221** possible consecutive
five-slot deletions are retained as diagnostic frames. Two illustrative
placements expose transport-related fragments, but neither establishes
a complete clean reading or a unique historical geometry. A1 remains outside
this package's A2/A3 totals. Its separate
[conditional first-part edition](#edition-cases-caucasus-poti-first-part-conditional) is now
included in the catalogue and preserves the unresolved frame alternatives.

The counted two records use **450 source slots**, **412 valid source
coordinates**, **20 observed-coordinate substitutions** and **26 dash
fills**, with **12 dashes still unfilled**. There is no length change,
source deletion or key change in these two records.

The published key and the earlier partial A2 repository candidate retain
their credit. No historical first-solution claim is made. The
[inputs](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/inputs.json),
[earlier candidates](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/prior_candidates.json)
and [reproduction instructions](../experiments/poti_horse_delivery/README.md)
preserve the full source and the limits of this reading.

**Edition context:** Nazareth evaluation office: request for news from the front.

<a id="edition-cases-radio-nazareth-front-inquiry-nazareth-evaluation-office-request-for-news-from-the-front"></a>

at Nazareth. It asks for news from the fighting front and marks the request

<a id="edition-cases-radio-nazareth-front-inquiry-conditional-interpretation-and-limits"></a>

### Conditional interpretation and limits

The code-like **AKONACH70**, **PHQ** and reference **95267** remain
literal. This edition does not expand them into an independently identified
office, formation, headquarters or date. The words establish what this
telegram requests; they do not independently establish the military situation.

There is no source-mask fill, substitution, insertion, deletion, frame change
or key change. The complete native plaintext re-encrypts to the exact 172
source coordinates. Manual inspection resolves the character losses in the
earlier OCR screen without altering the historical source.

The earlier repository screen already contained this body with three
OCR-induced question marks. That prior candidate and the published key
are credited. No historical first-solution claim is made.
